notes.title: From Colonizing the New World to Leading U.S. Campaigns!
notes.content:
Hello, Scramble fans!
In Election Tycoon: Trump vs Harris, we’re switching from colonizing the New World to dominating U.S. elections. You’ll need to manage resources, influence states, and outsmart opponents, just like you did in Scramble! If you love strategy and resource management, this is your chance to use those skills on a political stage!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3170840/Election_Tycoon_Trump_vs_Harris/
